title: Landing pages
help: One public page per product, very light (it opens fast even on 3G). Orders arrive in Pilotix; fake ones are blocked without the customer knowing.

about.pages: An order page per product: its colour, pictures and text. Share its address in your ads.
about.bloquees: Orders the fake-order check held back. The customer saw the normal thank-you screen; restore the real ones.
about.abandons: Customers who left their number without ordering: Pilotix adds them to Commandes › New by itself so your agents call them.
about.reglages: Meta pixel and Conversions API, abandoned orders, automations.
about.protection: What the fake-order protection did: orders passed, to check, blocked, and the attacks (one device sending many numbers, numbers in a row).
about.groupes: One page with several products: the customer picks one and lands on that product’s landing page.
about.evenements: What the server sent to Meta and TikTok, page by page: purchases, forms, started orders, fake orders.

lvlHelp.normal: Blocks at 70, to check at 40. Recommended.
lvlHelp.strict: Blocks at 55, to check at 30. For a product hit hard by fake orders.

set.footer: Pages load the Meta pixel only after they are shown (to stay fast on 3G), and never inside Pilotix (preview, demo).
set.metaHelp: The browser sends PageView, ViewContent and InitiateCheckout, nothing else: what the pixel sends by itself on every click (“SubscribedButtonClick”) is switched off. The server sends through the Conversions API: Lead when the form of a clean order arrives (an order "to check": when an agent confirms it); Purchase only for a real order (a blocked order or one marked fake is never a sale for Meta); FakeOrder and Competitor for the browser behind an order an agent marks fake, or a blocked order nobody restored in 24 hours. With those two, Pilotix makes two lists by itself in your Meta ad account (Advertising › Audiences): ads launched from Pilotix leave them out; for an ad made in Meta, pick them yourself in the exclusions.
set.pixelHint: Events Manager › Data sources. A page may have its own pixel.
set.testCodeHint: Events Manager › Test events. Clear it after testing.
set.tokenHint: Events Manager › your pixel › Settings › Generate a token. It never leaves the server.
set.tokenAdmin: Only the administrator can change it.
set.purchaseAt: When an order counts as a "Purchase" for Meta

paHelp.order: At once, when the fake-order check is sure. Fastest for Meta, but also counts customers who cancel later.
paHelp.confirmed: When an agent confirms by phone: Meta learns from real buyers.
paHelp.delivered: When the parcel is delivered and paid: the most accurate, but Meta learns it days later.

set.never: Never a Purchase for a blocked order, nor for one marked fake, duplicate, wrong number or cancelled before sending.
set.chats: Orders taken in Pilot Message (Messenger, Instagram) follow the same choice: Meta learns which chat became a real buyer.
set.urlParamsHelp: Each order keeps its campaign, ad set and ad. Pilotix adds them by itself (see below); otherwise, paste them in the ad: Meta › Ad › Tracking › URL parameters.
set.abandonedHelp: As soon as a customer types a valid number, Pilotix keeps it. If they do not order, their order goes to Commandes › New by itself, with no message to the customer: your agents call them.
set.afterHint: with no activity on the form (5 minutes at least)
set.autoCreate: Create a landing page for each new product
set.autoCreateHelp: Made when the product is created (name, photo, price, variants), to complete afterwards. Otherwise the product shows in "Pages" with an alert.
set.removeTokenAsk: Remove the Conversions API token? The ads key (your linked Facebook account) will be used instead, if there is one.
set.ignoredNone: None: every product on sale raises the alert until it has a page.
set.restored: The alert is back for this product
set.linkHelp: Every page has its own address: your site / the store's name / the page's name (the page's name is changed in the page). The old …/api/lp/… links keep working.
set.storeSlugHint: Latin letters, digits and dashes. Empty = « {{name}} » (made from the shop's name). After a change, links with the old name still lead to the right page.
set.storeFixed: Chosen when your shop was created, it never changes: your pages and all your Pilotix addresses (pilotix.online/{{name}}/…) use it.
set.tsHelp: An invisible check by Cloudflare (Turnstile), free: the customer sees nothing. A “robot” according to Cloudflare adds 40 points (never blocked by that alone). Create a widget at dash.cloudflare.com › Turnstile with your pages’ domain.
set.tsSiteHint: Public: it goes on the pages.
set.tsAutoHelp: Nothing to do: your landing pages are already protected, even on your own domain. Your own Cloudflare keys (optional) replace Pilotix’s.
set.ttParams: URL parameters for your TikTok ads
set.ttParamsHelp: Paste them in each TikTok ad (Ad › Destination › « URL parameters » / tracking URL). Each order keeps its TikTok campaign, ad group and ad.

ev.title: Events sent to Meta
ev.help: What the server sent (or not, and why). The Purchase of a fake order shows as "skipped", never "sent"; FakeOrder and Competitor tell Meta the browser (never the number typed) so your ads can leave it out.
ev.empty: Nothing sent yet (add the pixel ID).

alertHelp: On this device: a notification and a short sound when an order arrives from a landing page.

pHelp.max: Most faithful: no visible difference even zoomed in. Slightly heavier files.
pHelp.balanced: Recommended: no visible difference, files 2 to 4 times lighter than before. Ideal on 3G.
pHelp.light: Fastest (2G, weak 3G): a very slight loss when zooming, invisible on a phone.

ph.hint: Each photo is compressed in your browser: Pilotix finds the lowest quality that still looks the same as the original (measured), in 4 sizes (160, 480, 720, 960 px) + a blurred preview of a few bytes shown at once. A 4 MB photo reaches the customer as 30 to 80 KB. The first one is the main photo.
ph.gainHelp: Weight saved and quality: see before / after
ph.heavy_one: {{count}} photo comes from an address and is not compressed: it slows the page down.
ph.heavy_other: {{count}} photos come from an address and are not compressed: they slow the page down.
ph.fetchFail: This site does not let us read the photo. Save it on your phone, then add it with « Add photos ».
ph.urlKept: Photo added as is (the site does not let us compress it): it may be heavy.
ph.cmpLater: The side-by-side comparison is available right after adding the photo. Here is what the compression did:
ph.cmpSum: Original: {{orig}} ({{ow}} × {{oh}} px). On a phone the customer downloads {{phone}}, {{q}} % identical to the original.
ph.ssimHelp: « Identical »: measured similarity (MS-SSIM, at several scales like the eye) between the compressed photo and the original at the same size. Above 99 %, the eye sees no difference.
ph.takeHelp_one: {{count}} product photo is not on the page yet
ph.takeHelp_other: {{count}} product photos are not on the page yet
ph.takeNone: All the product’s photos are already on the page
ph.colourHelp: When the customer picks this colour, this photo shows big
ph.autoHelp: They follow the product: a changed photo, a new colour or a colour turned off in Products changes the page by itself.

domain.help: Your landing pages at your own address too: https://www.my-shop.com/<page>. Buy the domain from a registrar (OVH, Namecheap…), write it here, then point it to Pilotix. HTTPS comes by itself.
domain.label: Domain
domain.saved: Domain saved: point it to Pilotix
domain.notYet: The domain does not point to Pilotix yet (DNS can take a few hours)
domain.removeAsk: Remove this domain? Your pages stay on the Pilotix address.
domain.wait: Not yet: point the domain to Pilotix.
domain.how: At your registrar, in the domain’s DNS zone:
domain.name: Name
domain.howHelp: Delete the other A or AAAA records of this name. The change takes from a few minutes to a few hours.
domain.proofHelp: The TXT line proves this domain is yours: every domain points to the same Pilotix server, only its owner can add this TXT.
domain.proofMissing: The TXT line is not found yet: add it at your registrar, then “Check” (a few minutes to a few hours).

pr.intro: Every order received gets a score: 🟢 it passes, 🟡 an agent checks before calling, 🔴 it is blocked without the customer knowing (they see the same “Thank you”).
pr.kMergedSub: sent again by the same customer
pr.byHourHelp: Attacks often come at night, when nobody is watching.
pr.noBlocked: No blocked order in this period.
pr.attacksHelp: One device sending 3 numbers or more, or numbers in a row (same first 8 digits). “Block this device” blocks all its next orders.
pr.blockAsk: Block this device? All its next orders will go to “Blocked orders” (the customer will not know).
pr.whyHelp: The most frequent reasons, over {{count}} blocked or to-check orders.
pr.marksHelp: When an agent sets “Fake” or “🕵️ Competitor”, the device that ordered is marked: 🟡 next time, 🔴 at the 2nd fake within 30 days or right away for “competitor”. The phone number is not punished (it may belong to someone who never ordered).

gr.help: A group shows several products on one page. The customer taps a product and lands on its real landing page (same form, same protection), with « رجوع إلى كل المنتجات » at the top to go back to the group.

themeHelp.tabs: Tabs and a search box, like a small shop. Good for 15+ products.

idHint.tiktok: TikTok Ads Manager › Tools › Events › Web › your pixel (letters and digits).

token.tiktok: Events API token of this pixel

tokenHint.tiktok: TikTok Ads › Events › your pixel › Settings › « Generate access token ». Without it TikTok does not get the sales. It stays on the server.

mode.own: This page’s own number and message

at.title: Attack test
at.help: Launches real attacks on a landing page (robots, pranks, competitors, refusers) plus 100 real customers, through the real protection, to see how much gets through. Nothing is saved: no real order, no Meta event.
at.wait: A few seconds… sending hundreds of fake orders.
at.foot: « Passed » does not mean lost: a fake order that gets through is caught later (the customer refuses the parcel → trust score).
at.cf: Simulate Cloudflare (as on the live site)

why.sub_other: One picture for the whole shop: it shows on all your landing pages ({{count}} online). Change it here, it changes everywhere.
why.saved: Saved: all your pages are up to date.

evs.emptyOne: No event for this page in this period.
evs.note: One card per page. Tap a card to see its days and its last events. Visitors are counted by Pilotix (one per device and day): close to Meta’s number, not the same.
evs.chartLabel: Events sent per day, by type
evs.fakeWarn_one: {{count}} fake order: keep an eye on it
evs.fakeWarn_other: {{count}} fake orders: keep an eye on it

q.title: Match quality (Meta)
q.help: The score Meta gives each event of your pixels, out of 10: the higher, the better Meta recognises your customers. Read from Meta on {{at}}.
q.demo: Example (demo): in your shop these scores come from Meta.
q.none: Meta has no score for this pixel yet.
q.legend: Good from 7, medium from 5 to 6.9, bad under 5. FakeOrder and Competitor are low on purpose: that is normal.

g.title: What each event is for
g.help: What Pilotix sends by itself to Meta and TikTok. Nothing to set here: it is for understanding.

view.name: Page visit
view.why: Meta knows who looks at your products. Used for “saw the page” audiences.
view.when: when the customer opens the page (their browser sends it).

checkout.name: Order started
checkout.why: Meta knows who starts ordering. Used to reach those who did not finish.
checkout.when: when the customer starts filling the form.

lead.name: Form sent
lead.why: Meta knows who sent a real form, even if the order is cancelled later.
lead.when: when a safe form arrives; otherwise when an agent accepts it.

purchase.name: Purchase
purchase.why: The most important one: your “sales” ads learn on it.

at.order: at the order, if the anti-fraud check is sure.
at.confirmed: when an agent confirms by phone.

confirmed.name: Confirmed
confirmed.why: Tells Meta an agent confirmed an order already counted as a purchase.
confirmed.when: when an agent confirms by phone.

delivered.name: Parcel delivered
delivered.why: Meta knows who really paid. Used for audiences of real buyers, not as an ad’s goal (it arrives too late).
delivered.when: when the parcel reaches the customer.

fake.name: Fake order · Competitor
fake.why: Meta knows the fake customers’ browser to keep them out of your ads. Never the number typed.
fake.when: when an agent marks “Fake” or “Competitor”, or a day after a blocked order.

tm.title: Team and suppliers
tm.sub: Your team tests your pages without being blocked. Your suppliers are blocked.
tm.teamHelp: Their orders on your pages are tests: never blocked, nothing sent to Meta, counted nowhere, and they still see your ads. You see them in Protection › Team tests.
tm.suppliersHelp: Their orders are blocked without them knowing (they see “thank you”), and they are left out of your ads.
tm.accountsNone: Nobody in the team has a mobile number.
tm.stockNone: No supplier with a mobile number.
tm.name: Name (optional)
tm.adsOff: To leave them out of your ads too, turn on the “fake numbers” list in Advertising › Audiences.
tm.both: A number in both lists counts as Team.
tm.testsHelp: Your Team’s orders on your pages. They are not real orders: nothing is sent to Meta, nothing is counted.
tm.testsOff: Team is off: turn it on in Landing pages › Settings so your team can test.

tags.title: Automatic on your ads
tags.sub: Ads launched from Pilotix: always. Ads made in Meta: Pilotix adds them by itself during their first {{h}} hours (Meta reviews the ad once more).
tags.switch: Add the parameters to new ads made in Meta automatically

tags.savedOff: Off: Pilotix no longer touches ads made in Meta
tags.off: Off: Pilotix touches no ad made in Meta. Paste the line above in each ad yourself.
tags.allGood: All your ads to your pages have the parameters.
tags.missingHint: Their orders don’t know which ad they came from. Paste the line above in Meta: the ad › Tracking › URL parameters.

why.old: Made more than {{h}} h ago: add them in Meta
why.feed: Several texts, videos or formats: add them in Meta
why.catalog: Catalogue ad: add them in Meta
why.other: This kind of ad: add them in Meta
why.post: Existing post: Meta didn’t take the parameters, add them in Meta

tags.never: Not checked yet: the first check comes within 15 minutes.
